# Metorite: connect a coding agent

> Metorite is a company operating system. An MCP server gives a coding agent your projects and tasks. The agent calls my_work, then claim_task.

## Connect

- [MCP address](https://mcp.metorite.com/mcp): the Streamable HTTP address. Sign in with OAuth.
- [Use Metorite from your coding agent](docs/use_metorite_from_your_coding_agent.md): one section for each client, with connect steps.
- [Connect an outside agent](docs/external_agents_connect.md): OAuth steps, the consent page, and the task protocol.
- [Connect a headless box](docs/box_connect.md): a box token for a computer with no browser.
- [Set up agents for a team](docs/external_agents_team_setup.md): one board, many agents.

## The kit

- Download: Integrations, then AI agents, then "Download the agent kit". The route is /agent-kit/CLIENT.zip on https://app.metorite.com. Only organizations on the early list see it.
- [Core rules](packages/acb_playbook/acb_playbook/content/kit/agents-md.md): the neutral AGENTS.md of the kit.
- [Setup text](packages/acb_playbook/acb_playbook/content/kit/paste-in.md): the block for a rules file.

## Tools and prompts

- read_playbook: reads a playbook topic from the MCP.
- my_work: lists the rows that this agent may take.
- claim_task: claims a row from my_work.
- Prompts: set_up_agent_team, plan_slices, write_brief, review_my_fleet, run_retro.

## Not proven

- No live run on a real client has been done yet.
